title: eat shit & die 219
author: bpatrick
body: “Hey b., why did it take you four days to color this comic?” I honestly don’t know. I picked this comic to do because it was the shortest of the ones on deck. At any rate this made my whole week! An awesome display! Thank you! Now I wish I could draw better to be worthy of such a showing.

comments.author: Haemoglobin Juniour
comments.text: YAY another comic! I’ve checked back every day waiting for one. 🙂

comments.text: Heh, I’m glad I have your approval. I first thought the cardboard would look really cheap but I guess it looks fine on the wall after all. Well it’s you who did it! Cheers
